issues.details: Very little text content (25 chars) - likely JS-rendered, invisible to AI crawlers
issues.name: Content without JavaScript
issues.recommendation: Serve at least 500 characters of meaningful homepage content in raw HTML. Add a clear H1, keep deeper heading levels sequential, and remove excessive non-content markup.

issues.details: Nonexistent paths return HTTP 200 with the app shell (soft-404). Agents probing for resources conclude every path exists. Return a real HTTP 404 status for unknown paths.
issues.name: Agent-friendly 404s
issues.recommendation: Return a real HTTP 404 (or 410) status for nonexistent paths - never a 200 with your app shell, which makes agents believe every path exists. For full credit, give the 404 response a short markdown body pointing agents at your sitemap, llms.txt, or docs index. Verify with `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://yourdomain.com/some-path-that-does-not-exist` - it must print 404.

issues.name: OpenAPI spec published
issues.recommendation: Publish an OpenAPI (Swagger) specification at /openapi.json or /api/openapi.yaml. This is how agents understand your API surface automatically.

issues.details: API does not return JSON error responses (or no API detected)
issues.name: JSON error responses
issues.recommendation: Return structured JSON error responses with error codes, messages, and resolution hints. Agents can't parse HTML error pages.

issues.details: MCP server advertises resources capability but resources/list returned none
issues.name: MCP resources exposed
issues.recommendation: If your MCP server advertises the resources capability in its initialize handshake, make sure resources/list returns at least one resource. If you don't intend to expose resources, omit the capability - the check returns na with no penalty for tool-only servers. Quality of the resources you do return is scored separately by mcp-resource-quality.

issues.details: Not acceptmarkdown.com compliant: Accept: text/markdown returned text/html; charset=utf-8; Vary header missing Accept (got "accept-encoding")
issues.name: Markdown content negotiation (acceptmarkdown.com)
issues.recommendation: On the responses that serve text/markdown via Accept negotiation, add Accept to the Vary header (Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding). Without it, CDNs can serve the cached HTML variant to an agent asking for markdown (or vice versa), depending on which variant landed in cache first.

issues.details: "wheretolive" search returned 10 results but domain did not appear - brand may be too generic or not indexed
issues.name: Brand name discoverability
issues.recommendation: Make sure a clean search for your brand name returns your own domain in the top results. If it does not, your brand may be too generic, conflict with a more established term, or not yet indexed. Strengthen brand-name search by claiming consistent NAP across listings, earning press mentions that link to the canonical domain, and avoiding redirect chains that mask the apex domain in search results.

issues.details: No publicly reachable API surface detected (REST and GraphQL both absent or auth-gated)
issues.name: Public API with reachable endpoints
issues.recommendation: Expose a public REST or GraphQL API. AI agents need programmatic access  - not just a web UI  - to integrate with your product.

issues.name: Developer portal
issues.recommendation: Create a developer portal at /developers with API keys, documentation, quickstart guides, and a sandbox environment.

issues.details: No public API or documentation page linked from homepage
issues.name: Public API/docs linked from homepage
issues.recommendation: Publish API documentation at a discoverable URL (/docs, /api, /developers). Include authentication, endpoints, and example requests.

issues.details: No agent instruction file with when-to-use guidance found
issues.name: Agent instruction / when-to-use
issues.recommendation: Tell agents when to reach for you: add a 'when to use this' section to your llms.txt (or a dedicated agent-instructions file) that names your best-fit use cases and how an agent should call you. Be specific about the jobs you are right for - generic marketing copy does not read as guidance.

issues.details: No Organization type found in JSON-LD
issues.name: Organization schema completeness
issues.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD that includes both contactPoint (with email/phone and contactType) and address (PostalAddress). This lets AI verify your business legitimacy and answer contact queries.

issues.details: No trust anchor pages found with sufficient content (About, Contact, Privacy)
issues.name: Trust anchor pages
issues.recommendation: Publish real /about, /contact, and /privacy pages with at least 500 characters of content each. These are the pages AI agents check to verify your business is legitimate before recommending you.

issues.details: Name search surfaced no pages on wheretolive.la, although developer resources exist on the site (MCP server) - weak search indexing or transient search noise
issues.name: Developer resource discoverability
issues.recommendation: Make your developer resources (API docs, OpenAPI spec, auth docs, developer portal, MCP server) discoverable by name. Publish them at predictable URLs, list them in llms.txt, and include your product name in page titles and headings so search engines surface them for name-based queries.

issues.details: REST: OpenAPI spec found but failed to parse for complexity analysis
issues.name: API schema complexity analysis
issues.recommendation: Make your API spec self-describing: a unique operationId and a description on every operation, typed parameters, and response schemas. For GraphQL, a fully typed schema with a documented cost or rate limit reads best.

issues.details: API spec found but couldn't validate function calling compatibility
issues.name: Function calling compatibility
issues.recommendation: Ensure API endpoints have unique operation IDs, typed schemas, and descriptions compatible with LLM function-calling formats.

issues.details: Only 1/4 metadata signals present - missing: canonical URL, HTML lang attribute, og:image
issues.name: Metadata completeness
issues.recommendation: Add all four signals to your homepage: <link rel="canonical">, <html lang="...">, <meta property="og:image">, and <meta property="og:type">. Agents use these for entity resolution and attribution.

issues.name: CLI tool available
issues.recommendation: Publish an official CLI tool on npm, PyPI, or Homebrew. A CLI lets agents and developers script interactions with your product without building API integrations from scratch.
